fusions.name: Branding Iron
fusions.desc: Presses a hot brand into the target, which deals 8 damage, sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bellows Breath
fusions.desc: Bellows a cone of flame that deals 27 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and sets each target [Burning] for 10 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Cured Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds. You have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Stoked by Blows
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.
